A tiny state machine for complicated flows

npm i kernel Read the guide 
$ npx create-app my-project
✓ Installing dependencies
✓ Generating routes
✓ Ready in 1.2s

  Local  http://localhost:3000

Everything you need

2.1 kB minzipped

Small enough that nobody has to justify adding it.

Fully typed

States and events are inferred — no generics to write by hand.

Framework agnostic

Adapters for the big three, and it works without any of them.

Serialisable

Snapshot a machine, store it, restore it later.

14.2k GitHub stars
2.1 kB Bundle size
0 Dependencies
180+ Contributors

How it works

  1. 01

    Install

    npm, pnpm, yarn or a CDN script tag.

  2. 02

    Define

    Describe states and transitions in one object.

  3. 03

    Run

    Send events, read state, subscribe to changes.

Is it production ready?

Yes — v3 has been stable for two years and follows semver strictly.

Open an issue first. Good first issues are labelled and mentored.
